source_mode: Original locally authored connected palm/five-digit topology, original finger joints and hand-keyed motion. Reuse only this project's originally generated leather surface; no external model, rig, mocap or animation.
scope: Replace fused closed-fist topology with a genuinely articulatable original glove. Author one connected palm, separate thumb and four fingers, closed hidden wrist cap and semantic finger skin weights. Standalone source/GLB is a preparation for fitting the original human units, not a completed character or reload.
rig_decision: Prototype uses Hand plus 15 original finger joints per side, including separate thumb metacarpal, MCP and IP bones. Existing 20 character bind bones remain frozen; future character integration would add 30 original finger bones, with matching 50-bone hierarchy/binds on both LODs. Character integration and any added-bone registry contract remain unfinished.
source_approval: User explicitly requires original models, rigs and motion; locally authored original 3D source is the approved production direction. This candidate is not yet approved as finished art.
uv_policy: Intentional repeating UV for the original leather material; tile overlap/wrapping allowed. Opaque closed mesh, no alpha/key-color image processing applies.
local_mechanical_milestone: 2026-10-06 v6: four genus-zero skinned surfaces; 388 half-frame deformation samples, 1540 GLB parity poses and 48 Chromium views pass. Independent review accepts only the standalone articulation foundation.

Fit the actual characters and weapons, author full reload, and verify 50-bone runtime/portrait behavior
qa: Baseline real closed-fist mesh fails genus-zero and articulated-finger requirements
